# span start

The starting character offset (unicode code points, zero-based, inclusive) of a span — a Chunk within its source, or an EvidenceSpan within a chunk. Domain-free: one span idiom for the retrieval substrate and the evidence layer. The TYPED sharpening of the citations slice's gmeow:selectorTextPosition (which remains the home of non-numeric position locators); mechanical AIS checking (#55) needs integers, not prose.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/spanStart>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:spanStart`  

**Type:** `owl:DatatypeProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/ai>
